text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: service=autoscaler-queue-high severity=critical. Observed queue depth > 120k for /generate route in us-west-2 for 3m. links: https://grafana.company/dashboard?panel=autoscaler-queue

pagerduty-bot: Incident #PD-8342 created and paged: oncall@redwood. Escalation policy: primary -> secondary in 5m.

Ben: acked on PD, jumping in. seeing backlog spikes and scale-controller isn't responding to threshold. CPU on scale-controller 95%.

Alice: looks like controller manager OOMs in logs, repeating GC pause. pulling logs now.

Devon: tagging @Ben @Alice — quick customer impact check: are any customers timing out? SLOs?

Ben: yes, nginx 504s rising on prod-edge for several customers. error rate on /v1/chat up ~12% 5xx last 10m. top affected tenant: acme-payments (3% of global tokens).

Alice: paste logs:
```
k logs -n redwood autoscaler-controller-0
E0123 02:11:02.123 1 runtime: out of memory: cannot allocate 524288
fatal error: runtime: out of memory
```

Alice: autoscaler-controller restarted by k8s but keeps crashlooping.

Devon: immediate mitigation options: 1) manual horizontal scale of queue-workers; 2) move traffic off heavy tenants via routing rule; 3) increase controller memory (temp). Which is fastest?

Ben: manual hscale first. running:
```
k scale deployment queue-workers --replicas=80 -n prod
```

Ben: scale started, pods coming up but many in CrashLoopBackOff due to dependent KV cache pressure.

Maya: I'm on infra, can we add burst capacity nodes? AWS can provision g4dn quickly but need autoscaling group change. I can run temp pool.

Liam: I can flip routing to send non-critical traffic to degraded pool. propose: route /embeddings and large-batch jobs to fallback model-v1-slim.

Sasha: +1 to routing. adding a quick redirect rule in envoy:
```
- match: prefix:/embeddings
  route: fallback-cluster
```

Ben: doing canary change now. pushing rule and reloading envoy on frontends.

pagerduty-bot: PD escalation will go to secondary in 3m if not acknowledged by secondary.

incident-bot: Note: since controller is OOMing, rollouts and autoscale decisions will be stalled. Manual actions required until controller stable.

Alice: increased controller mem limit in deployment to 2Gi and restarted. logs show controller warmed, GC reduced. keeping eye.

Ben: queue-workers replicas stabilized at 64 healthy. queue depth dropping from 120k -> 45k in 6m. 5xx rate falling to 6%.

Devon: customer impact update: acme-payments saw ~14% requests retried/failures between 02:05-02:18 UTC, we opened support ticket and sent status update.

Maya: AWS burst pool coming up, terraform apply in progress to add 6 p4d-style nodes for capacity. ETA ~7m.

Liam: routing change live, embeddings traffic offloaded. tokens/sec from heavy tenants reduced 27%.

Sasha: running quick health checks:
```
curl -sS https://prod-edge/health | jq .
{"uptime":"ok","queue_depth":45678}
```

Ben: good progress. autoscaler-controller staying up since mem bump. leaving manual scale at 64 until controller confirmed stable for 20m.

pagerduty-bot: PD notify: secondary oncall (Maya) acknowledged. escalation stopped.

Devon: action items while hot: 1) Alice to scrub controller logs for root cause of OOM (leak vs dataset); 2) Eng-runtime to review memory settings and GC flags; 3) Maya to keep burst pool until queue < 5k; 4) Ben to coordinate customer comms and rollbacks if needed.

Alice: found repeated large KV snapshot loads during reconciliation causing memory spikes. suspects bug in reconciliation loop for stale models. filing issue --> https://jira.company/browse/ENGINF-5278

Maya: burst nodes healthy, added to prod pool. overall throughput increased 42%.

Ben: queue depth now 9,200 and dropping steadily. 5xx back to baseline ~0.8%.

Devon: We're moving to handoff. current status: degraded but stabilizing. still keeping PD incident open until queue < 5k and controller stable 30m.

Sasha: leaving notes for next shift:
- controller mem temporarily increased to 2Gi
- manual queue-workers replicas set to 64
- envoy routing rule to fallback for embeddings (ID: rb-2026-3111)
- burst pool active (6 nodes)

Ben: handing off to Maya for overnight monitoring. Maya — please ack receipt and timeline.

Maya: acked. I'll monitor metrics for 2h, will scale down burst nodes after queue < 2k and no regressions for 30m. will update PD status and customer comms.

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-8342 status updated: acknowledged, assigned to Maya, severity downgraded to major.

incident-bot: Reminder: capture timeline + commands run for postmortem. attach logs /screenshots to ticket ENGINF-5278.

Devon: thanks team. follow-up: schedule deeper root cause review with runtime and autoscaler owners tomorrow 1400 UTC.

Ben: adding retrospective note now. closing thread for active coordination.

Maya: I will post a 2h update if anything changes, otherwise will mark stable and request PD close once metrics hit targets. :thumbsup:
